title: Welcome to the Terminal
story: You're new here. Before anything else, learn where you are and how to look around.

files./home/player/welcome.txt:
Welcome to LinuxQuest, operator.
This terminal is a safe simulation, so explore freely.
Tip: there is a missions/ folder next door. Keep it in mind.
files./home/player/missions/first_clue.txt:
First clue: operators leave notes in plain text files.
You can read any file with cat. The trail starts here.

hints: The terminal always stands somewhere. One short command prints where.
Its name is short for print working directory: three letters.

objectives.success: Those are the files here. Names ending in / are folders.
hints: One command lists what a directory holds.

objectives.success: Printed. That is all reading a file is.
hints: cat prints a file to the screen.
Give it the file name: cat welcome.txt.
The file sits in your home directory.
